data.name: New Yankee in Santa's Service
data.detailed_description:
REMEDIUM: SENTINELS - OUT NOW!


SCHOLAR OF THE ARCANE ARTS - OUT NOW IN EARLY ACCESS


Acerca do jogo

Find Santa's missing reindeer to avoid a Yuletide cancellation! When Mary cast the spell that was supposed to take her and Johnny home at the end of New Yankee in King Arthur's Court 2, she goofed and scattered St. Nick's reindeer with a loud KABOOM! Now the bearded one is demanding Mary and Johnny collect his sleigh pullers before Christmas Eve. As you guide the hapless heroes and a band of merry elves through a winter wonderland, you'll need to carefully manage your time and resources. Plan well, and you'll be ready to defend your ground when evil Snowmen, cackling Ice Witches, and deadly Yeti attack! Don't miss this instant holiday classic!

Key Features:
  • Complete over four dozen levels!
  • Battle snowmen, witches, Yeti and more!
  • Assemble and repair a variety of buildings!
  • Cast powerful spells to complete tasks!
  • Search for Santa's missing reindeer!

reviews.review:
[h1] Information / Review English [/h1]

New Yankee in Santa's Service is a time management game developed by Rionix.

[h1] Gameplay / Story [/h1]

Play New Yankee in Santa's Service, a fun game to enjoy all year round. In the previous game in the hit series, Mary cast a spell to bring herself and her husband home, but instead, Santa's reindeer disappeared. At the festive New Yankee in Santa's Service, use time and resources to find the missing reindeer before Christmas. You collect resources, build buildings, remove obstacles or save various life beings in your adventure.

[h1] Pro [/h1]

+ Colorful animated worlds
+ Soundtrack, desktop backgrounds and other great extras
+ various difficulties, not too easy and not too difficult
+ many levels that offer a good number of hours of game time
+ same game mechanics as in the previous games
+ Trading cards

[h1] Contra [/h1]

- Level design repeats itself over time
- seen everything before in other games

[h1] Conclusion [/h1]

New Yankee in Santa's Service offers you a solid time management game, which stands out from the other parts with a few innovations. But personally I would wait for a sale.


[h1] Information / Review Deutsch [/h1]

New Yankee in Santa's Service ist ein Zeitmanagementspiel, welches von Rionix  entwickelt wurde. 

[h1] Gameplay / Story [/h1]

Spiele New Yankee in Santa's Service, ein lustiges Spiel, das du das ganze Jahr genießen kannst, Im vorherigen Spiel der Hitserie sprach Mary einen Zauber, um sich und ihren Mann nach Hause zu bringen, aber stattdessen verschwanden Santas Rentiere. Nutze im festlichen New Yankee in Santa's Service Zeit und Ressourcen, um die vermissten Rentiere vor Weihnachten zu finden. Du sammelst Ressourcen, baust Gebäude, entfernst Hindernisse oder rettest verschiedene Lebenwesen in deinem Abenteuer. 

[h1] Pro [/h1]

+ Farbenfroh animierte Welten
+ Soundtrack, Desktop-Hintergründe und weitere tolle Extras 
+ verschiedene Schwierigkeiten, nicht zu leicht und nicht zu schwer
+ viele Level, die eine gute Anzahl von Stunden Spielzeit bieten
+ gleiche Spielmechanik wie bei den vorherigen Spielen
+ Sammelkarten

[h1] Kontra [/h1]

- Leveldesign wiederholt sich mit der Zeit
- alles schon mal gesehen bei anderen Spielen

[h1] Fazit [/h1]

New Yankee in Santa's Service bietet dir ein solides Zeitmanagementspiel, welches auch durch wenige Neuerungen sich von den anderen Teilen abhebt. Ich würde persönlich aber auf ein Sale warten.
